items.scene: Cat slumped in an office chair with a tiny toy fishing rod secretly dipped into its coffee mug behind an open laptop. Half-closed cynical eyes, smug tiny grin, hilariously boneless posture.
Cat recoils so hard its tiny ears fly upright, mismatched giant eyeballs bulge, paws hold its cheeks, lower jaw drops almost to the floor. Total cartoon disbelief.
Overly eager cat salutes with both paws simultaneously, one eye squished shut by its own paw, standing rigidly in an absurdly oversized office tie.
Cat straps its entire tiny office desk and laptop onto its back and sprints away on comically spinning noodle legs. Desperate joyful escape face, loose tie flying behind.
Cat collapses into a few chunky puzzle-like pieces while a little translucent cat-shaped soul floats out of its mouth. Comical exhaustion, nonviolent and adorable, no injury.
Cat politely smiles and gives an awkward thumbs up while a tiny absurd volcano erupts from the top of its head. Twitching eyebrow, huge forced grin, office meltdown humor.
Cat is buried up to its neck in a bucket of popcorn, chin propped on paws, eyes gleefully widened at unfolding drama, mouth full and cheeks ridiculously swollen.
Cat leans close with a conspiratorial squint, one enormous approving thumb near the viewer, crooked knowing grin, tiny reading glasses perched low on nose.
Cat hides behind an absurdly small potted plant that conceals only its nose. Wide guilty eyes, frozen stiff paws gripping laptop, tail sticking out obviously.
Devastated cat holds an empty wallet wide open. One lonely fly emerges. Cat has hollow resigned eyes, ears droop, its other paw catches a single imaginary coin.
Panicked cat furiously types on a smoking laptop using six motion-blurred tangled paws, mismatched frantic eyes, giant sweat drops, tiny terrified zigzag mouth.
Cat sits perfectly upright in a tiny meditation pose wearing sunglasses, smiling far too calmly while a little office-paper tornado swirls around its head.
Cat stares completely blankly. The top of its head opens like a harmless cartoon lid to reveal one miniature smoking hamster wheel with a sleepy tiny hamster. No gore.
Cat dramatically facepalms with an oversized paw, one eye peeking through its fingers, other paw pointing at a wildly tangled cable knot. Deadpan bewilderment.
Cat leaps upward in an absurd starfish pose, mouth huge with delight, eyes sparkling, tiny pink cheeks, paper streamers trailing from both paws.
Cat slowly claps two tiny paws with a magnificently unimpressed face, one eyebrow extremely high, wearing an oversized bow tie. Comically sarcastic applause.
Cat flattened like a puddle-shaped pancake on the floor, its head barely lifted and only two exhausted eyes looking sideways. Limp paws, tiny soul puff, adorable office burnout.
Cat chases its own tail in a chaotic twisted running pose while balancing an absurd stack of papers. Spiral eyes, four motion-blurred feet, desperate panic.
Cat hugs a steaming coffee mug twice its own size, enormous black eyebags, trembling paws, tiny grateful smile and droopy ears. Coffee is an absurd life raft.
Cat lounges sideways in a tiny office chair like a retired emperor, paws behind head, feet on a giant overturned briefcase, bored puckered face and loose tie.
Mischievous cat peeks from behind a watermelon larger than its body, huge curious eyes and sly eyebrows, one paw cups its ear, wicked delighted grin.
Cat kneels with paws clasped together, enormous watery pleading eyes, ears flattened, body folded into an absurdly humble begging pose, one tiny sweat bead.
Cat bows so deeply its round head almost touches its feet, holding a tiny red gift envelope overhead with both paws. Ecstatic bashful face peeks between its legs.
Cat does a ridiculous energetic disco dance, loose office tie wrapped around its head, hips twisted, one paw points upward, eyes squeezed shut in pure joy, colorful confetti.
